documents.title: IITK-GSDMA Guidelines for Seismic Design of RC Buildings — Worked Design Example of a Six-Storey Building

chunks.title: Overview & Geometry
chunks.content:
MANAK BHAVAN, 9 BAHADUR SHAH ZAFAR MARG, NEW DELHI 110002
IITK-GSDMA GUIDELINES FOR SEISMIC DESIGN OF RC BUILDINGS · WORKED DESIGN EXAMPLE OF A S
Code Reference: IITK-GSDMA EQ26

chunks.title: 1. Problem Statement & Building Geometry
chunks.content:
Six-storey reinforced concrete office building located in Seismic Zone IV.
- Plan Dimensions: 4 bays @ 5.0 m in X-direction, 3 bays @ 4.0 m in Y-direction.
- Storey Height: 3.5 m typical, ground storey 4.0 m (Total building height = 21.5 m).
- Materials: Concrete Grade M25 (fck = 25 N/mm2), Reinforcement Fe 415 / Fe 500.
- Soil Condition: Medium soil (Type II), Foundation: Isolated footings with tie beams.
equations: - Storey Height: 3.5 m typical, ground storey 4.0 m (Total building height = 21.5 m).
- Materials: Concrete Grade M25 (fck = 25 N/mm2), Reinforcement Fe 415 / Fe 500.

chunks.title: 2. Gravity Load Evaluation
chunks.content:
Floor Dead Loads per IS 875 (Part 1):
- Slab thickness: 150 mm (Dead load = 0.15 * 25.0 = 3.75 kN/m2)
- Floor finishes and partitions: 1.50 kN/m2 (Total floor DL = 5.25 kN/m2)
Imposed Loads per IS 875 (Part 2):
- Typical floors: 3.0 kN/m2 (Office occupancy per Table 1)
- Roof floor: 1.5 kN/m2.
equations: - Slab thickness: 150 mm (Dead load = 0.15 * 25.0 = 3.75 kN/m2)
- Floor finishes and partitions: 1.50 kN/m2 (Total floor DL = 5.25 kN/m2)

chunks.title: 3. Seismic Base Shear Calculation per IS 1893 (Part 1):2016
chunks.content:
Seismic Weight W = Sum of dead loads + 25% of live loads (since LL <= 3.0 kN/m2 per Table 10).
Total Seismic Weight W = 16,850 kN.
Fundamental Natural Period:
Ta = 0.075 * h^0.75 = 0.075 * (21.5)^0.75 = 0.748 seconds.
For Medium Soil (Type II) with T = 0.748 s: Sa / g = 1.36 / T = 1.36 / 0.748 = 1.818.
Seismic Zone IV: Z = 0.24, Importance Factor I = 1.2 (Commercial), SMRF System R = 5.0.
Design Horizontal Acceleration Coefficient:
Ah = (Z / 2) * (I / R) * (Sa / g) = (0.24 / 2) * (1.2 / 5.0) * 1.818 = 0.05236.
Total Design Base Shear:
VB = Ah * W = 0.05236 * 16,850 = 882.2 kN.
equations: Total Seismic Weight W = 16,850 kN.

chunks.title: 4. Ductile Detailing Provisions per IS 13920:2016
chunks.content:
Beams: Width b = 300 mm, Depth D = 500 mm (d = 450 mm).
b >= 200 mm and b/D = 0.60 >= 0.30 (Complies with Cl. 6.1.1).
Support Plastic Hinge Confinement Zone (length 2d = 900 mm):
Stirrups spacing s <= min(d/4 = 112.5 mm, 8*db = 8*16 = 128 mm, 100 mm) => Use 100 mm c/c.
Ties have 135 degree hooks with 75 mm extension (>= 10*db per Cl. 5.2).

b >= 200 mm and b/D = 0.60 >= 0.30 (Complies with Cl. 6.1.1).

chunks.title: Overview & Geometry
chunks.content:
MANAK BHAVAN, 9 BAHADUR SHAH ZAFAR MARG, NEW DELHI 110002
IITK-GSDMA EXPLANATORY COMMENTARY AND PROPOSED DRAFT PROVISIONS ON DUCTILE DETAIL
Code Reference: IITK-GSDMA EQ06

chunks.title: 1. Purpose & Structural Philosophy
chunks.content:
Provides technical commentary for ductile detailing of reinforced concrete structures subjected to seismic forces.
Emphasizes capacity design principle: strong column - weak beam behavior to ensure energy dissipation
through flexural yielding of beams before column buckling or shear failure occurs.

chunks.title: 2. Beam Flexural Steel Envelope Rationale
chunks.content:
Commentary on Cl. 6.2: Restricting maximum tension steel ratio to 2.5% prevents brittle compression failure
of concrete under extreme cyclic strain reversals.
Minimum steel ratio ensures distributed micro-cracking rather than a single catastrophic fracture crack.

chunks.title: 3. Confinement Ties Mechanics
chunks.content:
Commentary on Cl. 7.6: Rectangular confining hoops provide passive lateral pressure when core concrete dilates,
dramatically enhancing ultimate compressive strain from 0.0035 to over 0.008.
135 degree seismic hooks embedded in core prevent ties from bursting outward after cover spalling.

documents.title: Design Aids to IS 456:1978 / SP:16 Worked Design Examples for Beams, Columns, and Slabs

chunks.title: Overview & Geometry
chunks.content:
MANAK BHAVAN, 9 BAHADUR SHAH ZAFAR MARG, NEW DELHI 110002
DESIGN AIDS TO IS 456:1978 / SP:16 WORKED DESIGN EXAMPLES FOR BEAMS, COLUMNS, AND SLABS
Code Reference: SP:16 Worked Examples

chunks.title: 1. Example 1: Singly Reinforced Rectangular Beam Flexure
chunks.content:
Design a simply supported rectangular beam over an effective span of 5.0 m.
Factored bending moment Mu = 120 kNm. Concrete M25 (fck = 25 N/mm2), Steel Fe 415 (fy = 415 N/mm2).
- Assumed beam width b = 250 mm.
- From SP:16 Table 2: Mu,lim / (b * d^2) = 3.45 N/mm2.
- Required effective depth d = sqrt(120 * 10^6 / (3.45 * 250)) = 373 mm. Adopt d = 400 mm, D = 450 mm.
- Required Ast = 982 mm2. Provide 3 bars of 20 mm diameter (Ast = 942 mm2 + 1 bar of 12 mm = 1055 mm2).
- Section is under-reinforced: xu < xu,max.
equations: Factored bending moment Mu = 120 kNm. Concrete M25 (fck = 25 N/mm2), Steel Fe 415 (fy = 415 N/mm2).
- Assumed beam width b = 250 mm.
- From SP:16 Table 2: Mu,lim / (b * d^2) = 3.45 N/mm2.
- Required effective depth d = sqrt(120 * 10^6 / (3.45 * 250)) = 373 mm. Adopt d = 400 mm, D = 450 mm.

chunks.title: 2. Example 2: Short Axially Loaded RC Column
chunks.content:
Design a short square column to carry factored axial load Pu = 1,500 kN.
Concrete M25, Steel Fe 500. Unsupported length L = 3.0 m.
- Minimum eccentricity: emin = L/500 + D/30 = 3000/500 + 400/30 = 19.3 mm <= 20 mm (Governs emin = 20 mm).
- Clause 39.3 axial capacity: Pu = 0.40 * fck * Ac + 0.67 * fy * Asc.
- Assume 1.2% longitudinal steel: Asc = 0.012 * Ag, Ac = 0.988 * Ag.
- 1500 * 10^3 = [0.40 * 25 * 0.988 + 0.67 * 500 * 0.012] * Ag = [9.88 + 4.02] * Ag = 13.90 * Ag.
- Required Ag = 107,913 mm2. Provide 350 mm x 350 mm column (Ag = 122,500 mm2).
- Required Asc = 1,470 mm2. Provide 4 bars of 20 mm diameter + 4 bars of 16 mm diameter (Asc = 2060 mm2).
- Lateral ties: dia >= max(20/4 = 5 mm, 8 mm) => Use 8 mm ties @ min(350 mm, 16*16 = 256 mm, 300 mm) => 250 mm c/c.
equations: Concrete M25, Steel Fe 500. Unsupported length L = 3.0 m.
- Minimum eccentricity: emin = L/500 + D/30 = 3000/500 + 400/30 = 19.3 mm <= 20 mm (Governs emin = 20 mm).
- Clause 39.3 axial capacity: Pu = 0.40 * fck * Ac + 0.67 * fy * Asc.
- Assume 1.2% longitudinal steel: Asc = 0.012 * Ag, Ac = 0.988 * Ag.
- Required Ag = 107,913 mm2. Provide 350 mm x 350 mm column (Ag = 122,500 mm2).
- Lateral ties: dia >= max(20/4 = 5 mm, 8 mm) => Use 8 mm ties @ min(350 mm, 16*16 = 256 mm, 300 mm) => 250 mm c/c.

chunks.title: 3. Example 3: Shear Reinforcement in Beams
chunks.content:
Beam breadth b = 300 mm, d = 450 mm, factored shear force Vu = 140 kN, M25 concrete, Fe 415 stirrups.
- Nominal shear stress tau_v = Vu / (b * d) = 140 * 10^3 / (300 * 450) = 1.037 N/mm2.
- tau_c,max for M25 = 3.1 N/mm2 per Table 20. tau_v < tau_c,max (Safe in shear compression).
- Concrete shear strength for pt = 1.0%: tau_c = 0.64 N/mm2 per Table 19.
- Since tau_v > tau_c, shear reinforcement is required:
Vus = Vu - tau_c * b * d = 140 - (0.64 * 300 * 450 / 1000) = 140 - 86.4 = 53.6 kN.
- Required spacing for 2-legged 8 mm stirrups (Asv = 100.5 mm2):
sv = 0.87 * fy * Asv * d / Vus = 0.87 * 415 * 100.5 * 450 / (53.6 * 10^3) = 304 mm.
- Maximum spacing limit per Cl. 26.5.1.5 = min(0.75 * 450 = 337 mm, 300 mm) => 300 mm.
- Minimum shear steel per Cl. 26.5.1.6: sv <= 0.87 * 415 * 100.5 / (0.4 * 300) = 302 mm.
- Provide 2-legged 8 mm stirrups @ 280 mm c/c.
equations: - Nominal shear stress tau_v = Vu / (b * d) = 140 * 10^3 / (300 * 450) = 1.037 N/mm2.
- tau_c,max for M25 = 3.1 N/mm2 per Table 20. tau_v < tau_c,max (Safe in shear compression).
- Concrete shear strength for pt = 1.0%: tau_c = 0.64 N/mm2 per Table 19.
- Required spacing for 2-legged 8 mm stirrups (Asv = 100.5 mm2):
- Maximum spacing limit per Cl. 26.5.1.5 = min(0.75 * 450 = 337 mm, 300 mm) => 300 mm.
